project: autohand/router: a Rust LLM router; 20 of its Markdown files, each changed at the same time by one developer and one agent
rules:
You are one of 40 contributors (20 coding agents and 20 developers) changing this repository's documentation at the same time. Work is coordinated with zit.
- Before you edit, claim what you will change: `zit claim <path>`, or one section with `zit claim '<path>#<Section heading>'`. If a claim is refused, someone else holds it: change a different part, or stop.
- `zit status` shows what everyone else is changing right now.
- Edit Markdown only. Do not run cargo or any build; zit runs the checks.
- Do not commit and do not push.
- End with a short report: what you changed, and why. It is stored with your change.
